Tool.howItWorksDesc: uses your browser's native APIs to process files entirely on your device. When you upload a file, it is read directly into browser memory. Processing occurs using JavaScript with no data transmitted over the network. The result is generated in memory and offered as an immediate download.

Tool.faqFreeAnswer: Yes, {tool} is completely free to use. There are no subscriptions, no credits to buy, and no hidden fees. You can use it as many times as you need.
Tool.faqUpload: Are my files uploaded to a server?
Tool.faqUploadAnswer: No. All processing happens entirely in your browser using JavaScript and browser APIs. Your files are never sent to any server. They stay on your device at all times, ensuring complete privacy.
Tool.faqFileSize: What is the maximum file size?
Tool.faqFileSizeAnswer: The file size limit depends on your device's available memory, as processing happens locally. Most tools support files up to 20–50MB. Larger files may cause slower processing depending on your device.
Tool.faqMobile: Does this tool work on mobile devices?
Tool.faqMobileAnswer: Yes! This tool is fully responsive and works on smartphones and tablets. It uses the same web browser APIs available on mobile browsers like Chrome, Safari, and Firefox.
Tool.faqBrowserAnswer: Modern browsers include powerful APIs like the Canvas API for image manipulation and the Web Crypto API for security operations. These allow complex file processing to happen directly on your device without any server involvement.
Tool.faqSupportedAnswer: This tool works on all modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. For best performance, we recommend using the latest version of your preferred browser.

Tool.steps_png-to-jpg_1Desc: Select your PNG image by clicking the upload area or dragging it onto the page. Your file stays entirely on your device throughout the process.
Tool.steps_png-to-jpg_2Desc: Set the output JPEG quality — higher values preserve more detail but increase file size. The default of 92% provides an excellent balance.
Tool.steps_png-to-jpg_3Desc: Click Convert to transform your PNG into a JPEG. The converted image downloads automatically — your original PNG remains untouched.
Tool.steps_jpg-to-png_1Desc: Select your JPEG image. PNG output supports transparency and lossless compression, making it ideal for logos, screenshots, and graphics with text.
Tool.steps_jpg-to-png_2Desc: PNG uses lossless compression, so no quality setting is needed. Your image will retain all visual detail from the original JPEG at the cost of a larger file size.
Tool.steps_jpg-to-png_3Desc: Click Convert to transform your JPG into a PNG. The result downloads immediately — your original file is never modified.
Tool.steps_video-to-gif_1Desc: Select a video file (MP4, WebM, or MOV) to convert. The video loads in your browser for frame-accurate GIF creation. Maximum file size is 50 MB.
Tool.steps_video-to-gif_2Desc: Choose the start time, duration, frame rate, and output dimensions. Lower frame rates and smaller dimensions produce smaller GIF files.
Tool.steps_video-to-gif_3Desc: Click Convert to render your video clip as an animated GIF. The resulting GIF is optimized for sharing on social media, messaging apps, and forums.
Tool.steps_mp4-to-gif_1Desc: Select an MP4 file to turn into an animated GIF. The video stays on your device — all processing happens locally in your browser.
Tool.steps_mp4-to-gif_2Desc: Set the clip duration, frame rate, and output size. Fewer frames per second and smaller dimensions result in much smaller GIF file sizes.
Tool.steps_mp4-to-gif_3Desc: Click Convert to generate your animated GIF. Perfect for creating reaction GIFs, tutorial clips, or social media content from your videos.
Tool.steps_webp-to-jpg_1Desc: Select a WebP image to convert. JPEG output ensures maximum compatibility with older software, social media platforms, and devices that don't support WebP.
Tool.steps_webp-to-jpg_2Desc: Adjust the output JPEG quality level. The default setting optimizes for a balance of visual quality and file size. Lower values produce smaller files.
Tool.steps_webp-to-jpg_3Desc: Click Convert to transform WebP to JPEG. The universal JPEG format ensures your image opens everywhere — your original WebP stays safe.
Tool.steps_jpg-to-webp_1Desc: Select a JPEG to convert to WebP. WebP typically reduces file size by 30-50% compared to JPEG while maintaining similar visual quality.
Tool.steps_jpg-to-webp_2Desc: Adjust the quality slider — WebP achieves excellent results at lower quality settings compared to JPEG. The default 80% typically looks great.
Tool.steps_jpg-to-webp_3Desc: Click Convert to produce a WebP file optimized for web performance. Smaller file sizes mean faster page loads while preserving image quality.
Tool.steps_webp-to-png_1Desc: Select a WebP image. Converting to PNG gives you lossless quality and transparency support — ideal for graphics, logos, and editing workflows.
Tool.steps_webp-to-png_2Desc: PNG uses mathematically lossless compression. Every pixel from your WebP is preserved exactly — the tradeoff is a larger file size than WebP.
Tool.steps_webp-to-png_3Desc: Click Convert to get a lossless PNG. Perfect for when you need the highest fidelity version of your image for further editing.
Tool.steps_png-to-webp_1Desc: Select a PNG image. Converting to WebP dramatically reduces file size — often 50-70% smaller than PNG — while keeping excellent visual quality.
Tool.steps_png-to-webp_2Desc: Adjust the quality setting. WebP preserves transparency from PNG files automatically, making it the best modern replacement for PNG on the web.
Tool.steps_png-to-webp_3Desc: Click Convert to produce a compact WebP file. Ideal for websites where fast loading matters and PNG file sizes are too large.
Tool.steps_heic-to-jpg_1Desc: Select HEIC images from your iPhone or iPad. HEIC is Apple's default photo format — converting to JPEG ensures compatibility with all devices and platforms.
Tool.steps_heic-to-jpg_2Desc: Adjust the JPEG quality level. Higher settings preserve more detail from the original HEIC photo. The default setting works well for most photos.
Tool.steps_heic-to-jpg_3Desc: Click Convert to transform HEIC into universally compatible JPEG files. Share, upload, or edit your photos anywhere — no Apple device required.
Tool.steps_heic-to-png_1Desc: Select HEIC images from Apple devices. PNG conversion gives you lossless quality for editing, printing, or archival purposes.
Tool.steps_heic-to-png_2Desc: PNG format preserves every detail at full resolution. Expect larger file sizes than HEIC or JPEG — this is the tradeoff for perfect quality.
Tool.steps_heic-to-png_3Desc: Click Convert to get a lossless PNG version of your photo. Ideal for professional editing workflows where quality matters most.
Tool.steps_avif-to-jpg_1Desc: Select an AVIF file. AVIF is a next-generation format with excellent compression, but JPEG ensures compatibility with all software and platforms.
Tool.steps_avif-to-jpg_2Desc: Adjust the output JPEG quality. The converter preserves color accuracy while producing a universally readable JPEG file.
Tool.steps_avif-to-jpg_3Desc: Click Convert to transform AVIF into JPEG. Your image will open anywhere — from legacy software to social media platforms.
Tool.steps_avif-to-png_1Desc: Select an AVIF image. Converting to PNG provides lossless quality for editing, printing, or situations where maximum fidelity is required.
Tool.steps_avif-to-png_2Desc: PNG preserves every pixel with no compression artifacts. The result is a perfect-quality image — larger in file size but visually identical.
Tool.steps_avif-to-png_3Desc: Click Convert to get a lossless PNG version. Best for graphic design, printing, or any workflow demanding pixel-perfect output.
Tool.steps_svg-to-png_1Desc: Select an SVG vector graphic. Converting to PNG rasterizes the vector paths into a pixel image at your chosen resolution.
Tool.steps_svg-to-png_2Desc: Choose the width and height for the PNG output. Larger dimensions give more detail but produce bigger files. The aspect ratio is preserved from the SVG.
Tool.steps_svg-to-png_3Desc: Click Convert to render your SVG as a PNG at the specified size. Perfect for sharing icons, logos, and illustrations as standard image files.
Tool.steps_svg-to-jpg_1Desc: Select an SVG file. Converting to JPEG rasterizes the vector artwork for sharing on platforms that don't accept SVG uploads.
Tool.steps_svg-to-jpg_2Desc: Choose output dimensions and JPEG quality. Note that JPEG does not support transparency — any transparent areas become white.
Tool.steps_svg-to-jpg_3Desc: Click Convert to get a JPEG version of your vector graphic. Ideal for uploading illustrations to social media or embedding in documents.
Tool.steps_compress-image_1Desc: Select one or more images to compress. Supported formats include JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, and HEIC. All processing stays on your device.
Tool.steps_compress-image_2Desc: Adjust the quality percentage — lower numbers mean smaller files but more visible compression. Find the sweet spot between size and quality for your use case.
Tool.steps_compress-image_3Desc: Click Compress to reduce file sizes. Compare original vs compressed sizes shown after processing. Download individually or as a batch.
Tool.steps_remove-bg_1Desc: Select a photo or graphic with a background you want to remove. Supported formats include JPEG, PNG, and WebP. The image stays on your device — no server upload.
Tool.steps_remove-bg_2Desc: Click Remove Background — the AI model runs entirely in your browser. The first time may take a few seconds while the model loads and caches; subsequent runs are faster.
Tool.steps_remove-bg_3Desc: Download the transparent PNG for use in design tools, presentations, e-commerce listings, or social media.
Tool.steps_resize-image_1Desc: Select an image to resize. Supported formats include JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, and HEIC. Your original stays untouched on your device.
Tool.steps_resize-image_2Desc: Enter the desired width and height in pixels. Toggle aspect ratio lock to maintain proportions or unlock for custom dimensions. Choose a preset size for common uses.
Tool.steps_resize-image_3Desc: Click Resize to generate the downsized (or upsized) image. Download the result — perfect for web optimization, social media, or email attachments.
Tool.steps_crop-image_1Desc: Select an image to crop. The full image loads in the cropping area where you can visually select the region to keep.
Tool.steps_crop-image_2Desc: Drag the crop handles to select your desired area. Choose a preset aspect ratio (1:1, 4:3, 16:9) or freely adjust. Preview updates in real time.
Tool.steps_crop-image_3Desc: Click Crop to apply the selection. The cropped image downloads immediately — your original remains intact for future edits.
Tool.steps_rotate-image_1Desc: Select an image to rotate or flip. The preview shows your current image orientation. All transformations are non-destructive to your original file.
Tool.steps_rotate-image_2Desc: Click to rotate 90°, 180°, or 270°. Use flip horizontal or vertical for mirror effects. Preview updates with each click so you can see the result immediately.
Tool.steps_rotate-image_3Desc: Click the rotation button to finalize. Download the correctly oriented image — no more sideways photos in your gallery or presentations.
Tool.steps_image-filter_1Desc: Select a photo or image to apply filters. The preview loads immediately so you can see changes in real time as you adjust each setting.
Tool.steps_image-filter_2Desc: Tweak brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, blur, and special effects (grayscale, sepia, invert, sharpen). Each adjustment shows instantly on the preview.
Tool.steps_image-filter_3Desc: Satisfied with the look? Click Apply to render the final image with all filters. Download your edited photo — the original stays untouched.
Tool.steps_image-to-pdf_1Desc: Select one or more images to combine into a PDF. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP. Drag to reorder images in the sequence they should appear.
Tool.steps_image-to-pdf_2Desc: Set page size (A4, Letter, or custom), image fitting mode, and margins. Preview the thumbnail layout to verify page order and appearance.
Tool.steps_image-to-pdf_3Desc: Click Generate to create a PDF document from your images. Each image becomes a separate page. Download the completed PDF immediately.
Tool.steps_merge-pdf_1Desc: Select two or more PDF files to combine. Drag to reorder them in the file list — the first file becomes page 1 of the merged document.
Tool.steps_merge-pdf_2Desc: Drag and drop files to set the merge order. Remove any files you don't want included. Preview the file count and total pages before merging.
Tool.steps_merge-pdf_3Desc: Click Merge to combine all PDFs into a single document. The merged PDF downloads automatically with pages in your specified order.
Tool.steps_split-pdf_1Desc: Select the PDF you want to split. The file loads in your browser and the total page count is displayed. No pages are uploaded to any server.
Tool.steps_split-pdf_2Desc: Select how to split — extract specific pages, split every N pages, or split by page ranges. Enter page numbers or ranges separated by commas.
Tool.steps_split-pdf_3Desc: Click Split to separate your PDF. Each resulting file downloads individually or as a ZIP containing all split documents.
Tool.steps_pdf-compress_1Desc: Select a PDF file to compress. Large PDFs with embedded images benefit most from compression. Your file never leaves your device.
Tool.steps_pdf-compress_2Desc: Select the compression strength. Higher compression creates smaller files but may reduce image quality. Preview the estimated size reduction before committing.
Tool.steps_pdf-compress_3Desc: Click Compress to reduce your PDF file size. Compare original vs compressed sizes. Ideal for emailing documents that exceed attachment limits.
Tool.steps_pdf-encrypt_1Desc: Select the PDF you want to password-protect. Your document stays entirely on your device — no file data is sent over the network.
Tool.steps_pdf-encrypt_2Desc: Enter a strong password and confirm it. Choose whether to also restrict printing, copying, or editing. Use a password you can remember — there is no recovery.
Tool.steps_pdf-encrypt_3Desc: Click Encrypt to apply password protection. The encrypted PDF downloads immediately. Share the password securely with intended recipients only.
Tool.steps_pdf-decrypt_1Desc: Select a password-protected PDF. You must know the password to unlock it — there is no way to bypass encryption without the correct password.
Tool.steps_pdf-decrypt_2Desc: Type the document's password. The tool attempts to decrypt using this password. If successful, the PDF is unlocked instantly in your browser.
Tool.steps_pdf-decrypt_3Desc: Once decrypted, download the unlocked PDF. The file is now freely accessible without a password — store it securely if it contains sensitive information.
Tool.steps_pdf-watermark_1Desc: Select the PDF to watermark. Your document is processed entirely in your browser — no pages are sent to any external server.
Tool.steps_pdf-watermark_2Desc: Enter the watermark text, choose font size, opacity, rotation angle, and position on the page. Preview the watermark appearance before applying.
Tool.steps_pdf-watermark_3Desc: Click Apply to stamp the watermark onto every page. Download the watermarked PDF — perfect for copyright protection, branding, or draft labeling.
Tool.steps_pdf-to-txt_1Desc: Select a PDF to extract text from. Works best with text-based PDFs (not scanned images). The extraction runs entirely in your browser.
Tool.steps_pdf-to-txt_2Desc: Click Extract to pull all text content from the PDF. The extracted text preserves paragraph structure where possible. Results appear in the text area.
Tool.steps_pdf-to-txt_3Desc: Review the extracted text, make any corrections, then copy to clipboard or download as a .txt file. Perfect for repurposing PDF content.
Tool.steps_pdf-to-csv_1Desc: Select a PDF containing tables or structured data. Best results come from PDFs with clearly formatted tables rather than free-form layouts.
Tool.steps_pdf-to-csv_2Desc: Click Extract to detect and pull table structures from your PDF. The tool attempts to identify rows and columns from the document layout.
Tool.steps_pdf-to-csv_3Desc: Review the extracted data in the preview table, then download as a CSV file ready for Excel, Google Sheets, or database import.
Tool.steps_pdf-to-word_1Desc: Select the PDF to convert to Word format. The converter preserves text, formatting, images, and layout as closely as possible to the original.
Tool.steps_pdf-to-word_2Desc: Click Convert to transform your PDF into an editable Word document. Conversion runs locally — your document content never leaves your browser.
Tool.steps_pdf-to-word_3Desc: Download the .docx file and open it in Microsoft Word, Google Docs, or LibreOffice. Edit, format, and collaborate freely with the converted document.
Tool.steps_word-to-pdf_1Desc: Select a .docx file to convert. The converter renders your Word document to PDF with text, images, and formatting preserved.
Tool.steps_word-to-pdf_2Desc: Click Convert to generate a PDF from your Word document. The PDF will look identical to how the document appears in Word. Processing is local and private.
Tool.steps_word-to-pdf_3Desc: Download the generated PDF. Perfect for sharing finalized documents, submitting assignments, or creating print-ready files from your Word documents.
Tool.steps_json-formatter_1Desc: Paste minified or messy JSON into the input area. The formatter accepts any valid JSON — arrays, objects, deeply nested structures. Your data stays in your browser.
Tool.steps_json-formatter_2Desc: Click Format to pretty-print with indentation, or Validate to check for syntax errors. Error messages point to the exact line and character of any issues.
Tool.steps_json-formatter_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the formatted JSON to your clipboard. Ready to paste into your code editor, API client, or documentation with proper indentation.
Tool.steps_base64_1: Enter text or upload a file
Tool.steps_base64_1Desc: Type or paste text to encode, or paste a Base64 string to decode. You can also upload a file to encode its contents. All processing is local.
Tool.steps_base64_2Desc: Click Encode to convert text/file to Base64, or Decode to convert Base64 back to its original form. Toggle between modes as needed.
Tool.steps_base64_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the encoded/decoded output. Use in your code, API requests, data URIs, or anywhere Base64 encoding is required.
Tool.steps_uuid-generator_1Desc: Select UUID version (v1 time-based or v4 random). Choose output format — single UUID, multiple UUIDs, uppercase, or with/without hyphens.
Tool.steps_uuid-generator_2Desc: Click Generate to create cryptographically random UUIDs. Each UUID is globally unique — the probability of collision is astronomically low.
Tool.steps_uuid-generator_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the generated UUID(s). Perfect for database primary keys, API request IDs, session tokens, or any unique identifier need.
Tool.steps_timestamp-converter_1Desc: Paste a Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds) or type a human-readable date. The converter automatically detects the input format.
Tool.steps_timestamp-converter_2Desc: Results display in multiple formats: Unix seconds, milliseconds, ISO 8601, RFC 2822, and local time strings. All timezone conversions are handled automatically.
Tool.steps_timestamp-converter_3Desc: Click any output format to copy it to your clipboard. Ideal for debugging API timestamps, configuring cron jobs, or converting between date representations.
Tool.steps_json-validator_1Desc: Paste the JSON you want to validate. The validator accepts any JSON structure — from simple key-value pairs to deeply nested API responses.
Tool.steps_json-validator_2Desc: Click Validate to check your JSON. Errors are highlighted with the exact line, column, and a description of what went wrong. Fix issues and re-validate.
Tool.steps_json-validator_3Desc: Once valid, copy the formatted JSON or download it. Use the validated data confidently in your application knowing it has correct syntax.
Tool.steps_regex-tester_1Desc: Type a regular expression pattern and optionally set flags (g, i, m, s, u). Use the cheatsheet reference if you need help with regex syntax.
Tool.steps_regex-tester_2Desc: Paste or type the text to test against. Matches are highlighted in real time as you type. Capture groups are shown individually for each match.
Tool.steps_regex-tester_3Desc: Copy your finalized regex pattern or the matched results. Ideal for debugging regex before adding it to your production code.
Tool.steps_text-case_1Desc: Type or paste the text you want to transform. Any length is supported — from a single word to a full document. Processing is instant and local.
Tool.steps_text-case_2Desc: Select from lowercase, UPPERCASE, Title Case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, or CONSTANT_CASE. The result previews immediately.
Tool.steps_text-case_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the converted text. Perfect for renaming variables, normalizing user input, or formatting text for different programming conventions.
Tool.steps_lorem-ipsum_1Desc: Choose the number of paragraphs, sentences per paragraph, and whether to start with the classic "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet..." opening.
Tool.steps_lorem-ipsum_2Desc: Click Generate to create Lorem Ipsum text. The generator produces readable pseudo-Latin that mimics the visual rhythm of natural language.
Tool.steps_lorem-ipsum_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the generated text. Use it as placeholder content in your designs, mockups, wireframes, or development previews.
Tool.steps_hash-generator_1Desc: Type or paste the string you want to hash. For file checksums, upload a file instead. All hashing is performed locally in your browser.
Tool.steps_hash-generator_2Desc: Choose from MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512. SHA-256 is recommended for most security-sensitive applications. Results appear instantly.
Tool.steps_hash-generator_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the generated hash. Use for file integrity verification, password storage (with salt), or data deduplication checks.
Tool.steps_qr-reader_1Desc: Select an image containing a QR code. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP. You can also use your camera to scan a QR code directly with your device.
Tool.steps_qr-reader_2Desc: Click Scan to decode the QR code. The tool extracts the embedded data — URLs, text, contact info, Wi-Fi credentials, or any encoded content.
Tool.steps_qr-reader_3Desc: Copy the decoded text or, if it's a URL, click to open it directly. Verify QR codes before scanning unknown ones for security.
Tool.steps_csv-formatter_1Desc: Paste raw CSV text or upload a .csv file. The formatter automatically detects delimiters (comma, tab, semicolon) and handles quoted fields.
Tool.steps_csv-formatter_2Desc: Click Format to align columns and validate the CSV structure. Error rows are flagged if they have mismatched column counts or malformed quoting.
Tool.steps_csv-formatter_3Desc: Copy the formatted CSV or download as a cleaned .csv file. Ready for import into Excel, Google Sheets, databases, or data analysis tools.
Tool.steps_xml-formatter_1Desc: Paste minified or messy XML into the input area. The formatter handles nested elements, attributes, CDATA sections, and processing instructions.
Tool.steps_xml-formatter_2Desc: Click Format to pretty-print with proper indentation. Validation catches mismatched tags, unclosed elements, and structural errors with clear messages.
Tool.steps_xml-formatter_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the clean, indented XML. Perfect for reviewing configuration files, SOAP responses, or any XML-based data format.
Tool.steps_yaml-formatter_1Desc: Paste YAML content into the input area. The formatter handles nested mappings, sequences, anchors, aliases, and multi-line strings.
Tool.steps_yaml-formatter_2Desc: Click Format to normalize indentation and spacing. Validation catches syntax errors like incorrect indentation, invalid characters, or duplicate keys.
Tool.steps_yaml-formatter_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the clean YAML output. Ideal for reviewing Kubernetes manifests, CI/CD configs, Docker Compose files, or any YAML-based configuration.
Tool.steps_markdown-formatter_1Desc: Type Markdown in the editor or paste existing content. The live preview panel shows how formatted output will look as you type.
Tool.steps_markdown-formatter_2Desc: Toggle between edit and preview modes. The formatter supports headings, bold, italic, code blocks, tables, links, images, and task lists.
Tool.steps_markdown-formatter_3Desc: Copy the rendered HTML or raw Markdown. Use for README files, documentation, blog posts, forum content, or any Markdown-based writing.
Tool.steps_word-counter_1Desc: Type or paste your text into the input area. The counter updates in real time as you type — no button click needed.
Tool.steps_word-counter_2Desc: See word count, character count (with and without spaces), sentence count, paragraph count, and estimated reading time — all updating live.
Tool.steps_word-counter_3Desc: Copy the full text or individual statistics. Clear the input to start fresh. Perfect for essay writing, SEO content planning, or translation work.
Tool.steps_qr-code_1Desc: Type or paste the URL, text, or data you want to encode in the QR code. QR codes can store URLs, plain text, contact info, or Wi-Fi credentials.
Tool.steps_qr-code_2Desc: Adjust size, foreground and background colors, and error correction level. Higher error correction makes the code more resilient to damage or obstruction.
Tool.steps_qr-code_3Desc: Click Download to save the QR code as a PNG image. Use it in print materials, signage, business cards, or share it digitally.
Tool.steps_password-generator_1Desc: Choose password length and character types — uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols. Longer passwords with all character types provide maximum security.
Tool.steps_password-generator_2Desc: Click Generate to create a cryptographically random password using your browser's secure random number generator. Each generation is completely independent.
Tool.steps_password-generator_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the password. Paste it directly into a password manager — never store passwords in plain text files or email them to yourself.
Tool.steps_timezone-converter_1Desc: Default cities show major time zones. Search and add any of 35+ world cities to your view. Each card shows the current local time updated every second.
Tool.steps_timezone-converter_2Desc: See real-time clocks for all selected cities. Toggle custom date/time to plan meetings — set a candidate time and check what hour it is in every city.
Tool.steps_timezone-converter_3Desc: Use the overview to identify overlap windows where all participants have reasonable working hours. Remove cities you don't need for a cleaner view.
Tool.steps_ip-lookup_1Desc: Type an IP address to look up, or leave blank to detect your own IP automatically. Your IP is detected on page load for immediate results.
Tool.steps_ip-lookup_2Desc: Results show country, city, ISP, ASN, coordinates, and timezone. All processing happens in your browser — no personal data is stored or tracked.
Tool.steps_ip-lookup_3Desc: Click "View on Google Maps" to see the IP's approximate geographic location. Copy any field by clicking it for use in logs or documentation.
Tool.steps_ocr-tool_1Desc: Select an image containing text — screenshots, scanned documents, or photos of signs. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP. Max file size: 50 MB.
Tool.steps_ocr-tool_2Desc: Choose the text language (English, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese). Click Extract Text. First run downloads language data (~10-20 MB) — subsequent runs are faster.
Tool.steps_ocr-tool_3Desc: Review the extracted text, make corrections in the editor, then copy to clipboard or download as a .txt file. The text area is editable for easy fixes.
Tool.steps_us-address-generator_1: Select a state or use random
Tool.steps_us-address-generator_1Desc: Choose a specific US state from the dropdown or leave it on Random for geographic variety. Tax-free states (Alaska, Delaware, Montana, New Hampshire, Oregon) are marked with a ★.
Tool.steps_us-address-generator_2Desc: Click Generate to create a complete US address package — full name, gender, street address, city, state, ZIP code, and a state-matched phone number with a real area code.
Tool.steps_us-address-generator_3Desc: Click any field to copy just that value to your clipboard. Use Copy All for the full formatted address. The toast notification confirms every copy. The map shows the city location via OpenStreetMap.
Tool.steps_base-convert_1Desc: Type a number in any base (binary, octal, decimal, or hexadecimal). The converter auto-detects the input base from your number's format.
Tool.steps_base-convert_2Desc: View conversions to all common bases simultaneously — binary (base 2), octal (base 8), decimal (base 10), and hexadecimal (base 16).
Tool.steps_base-convert_3Desc: Click any output to copy it. Perfect for programming tasks, network addressing, color code conversion, or computer science education.
Tool.steps_random-number_1Desc: Enter minimum and maximum values for your random number range. You can generate integers or decimals within any range supported by JavaScript.
Tool.steps_random-number_2Desc: Click Generate to produce a truly random number within your specified range. Generate single values or multiple numbers at once for batch use.
Tool.steps_random-number_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the generated number(s). Use for dice rolls, lottery simulations, randomized test data, game mechanics, or statistical sampling.
Tool.steps_binary-calculator_1Desc: Type binary numbers (0s and 1s) or decimal numbers in the input fields. The calculator displays both representations for clarity.
Tool.steps_binary-calculator_2Desc: Choose an operation — addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division. Results are shown in both binary and decimal formats simultaneously.
Tool.steps_binary-calculator_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the result in binary or decimal format. Ideal for computer architecture coursework, bit-level debugging, or learning binary arithmetic.
Tool.steps_boolean-calculator_1Desc: Type your logical expression using AND (∧), OR (∨), NOT (¬), XOR (⊕), and parentheses for grouping. Use 0/1 or true/false as input values.
Tool.steps_boolean-calculator_2Desc: Click Evaluate to compute the boolean result. A truth table is generated showing all possible input combinations and their outputs.
Tool.steps_boolean-calculator_3Desc: Copy the result value or the full truth table. Essential for digital logic design, programming conditionals, and formal logic study.
Tool.steps_bitwise-calculator_1Desc: Type two numbers in decimal, hex (0x prefix), or binary (0b prefix). Both values are shown in all three representations for verification.
Tool.steps_bitwise-calculator_2Desc: Select AND (&), OR (|), XOR (^), NOT (~), left shift (<<), or right shift (>>). Results update instantly in decimal, hex, and binary.
Tool.steps_bitwise-calculator_3Desc: Click any output format to copy it. Essential for low-level programming, embedded systems, flag manipulation, and performance optimization.
Tool.steps_ip-calculator_1Desc: Type an IP address with CIDR notation (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24) or with a subnet mask. The calculator auto-detects the input format.
Tool.steps_ip-calculator_2Desc: See network address, broadcast address, usable host range, total hosts, subnet mask, and wildcard mask — all calculated instantly.
Tool.steps_ip-calculator_3Desc: Click any field to copy it. Essential for network engineers, sysadmins, DevOps, and anyone configuring firewalls, routing, or VLANs.
Tool.steps_time-diff_1Desc: Input a start date/time and an end date/time using the datetime pickers. Both past and future dates are supported for any calculation direction.
Tool.steps_time-diff_2Desc: Click Calculate to see the exact time span between your dates. Results break down into years, months, days, hours, minutes, and seconds.
Tool.steps_time-diff_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the time difference. Useful for project planning, age calculation, countdown timers, SLA tracking, and event scheduling.
Tool.steps_bmi-calculator_1Desc: Input your weight and height. Switch between metric (kg/cm) and imperial (lbs/ft/in) units. Your data stays private — all calculations are local.
Tool.steps_bmi-calculator_2Desc: Your BMI score and weight category (underweight, normal, overweight, or obese) display instantly. A visual scale shows where your result falls on the range.
Tool.steps_bmi-calculator_3Desc: Review the BMI category description. Note that BMI is a screening tool, not a diagnostic — consult a healthcare professional for personalized health advice.
Tool.steps_loan-calculator_1Desc: Input the loan amount, annual interest rate, and loan term in years or months. All calculations run locally in your browser for privacy.
Tool.steps_loan-calculator_2Desc: See your monthly payment, total interest paid, total amount repaid, and full amortization schedule. Adjust any input to see updated results instantly.
Tool.steps_loan-calculator_3Desc: Copy the monthly payment amount or full schedule. Use for mortgage planning, auto loan comparison, personal loan evaluation, or financial education.
Tool.steps_matrix-calculator_1Desc: Input your matrices by typing values or using the grid editor. Supported sizes from 1×1 to 10×10. Define both matrices if the operation uses two.
Tool.steps_matrix-calculator_2Desc: Choose add, subtract, multiply, transpose, determinant, or inverse. The result matrix displays instantly with all computed values.
Tool.steps_matrix-calculator_3Desc: Copy individual values or the entire result matrix. Essential for linear algebra coursework, 3D graphics programming, and engineering calculations.
Tool.steps_string-analyzer_1Desc: Type or paste any text into the input. The analyzer processes it instantly with no button click needed — everything updates in real time.
Tool.steps_string-analyzer_2Desc: See character count, word count, byte length (UTF-8), line count, entropy, unique characters, and character frequency distribution.
Tool.steps_string-analyzer_3Desc: Click any statistic to copy it. Useful for developers debugging encoding issues, SEO content optimization, password entropy checking, and text processing.
Tool.steps_date-calculator_1Desc: Pick a base date using the date picker. Use today's date or any past/future date as your starting point for the calculation.
Tool.steps_date-calculator_2Desc: Enter the number of days, weeks, months, or years to add or subtract. Choose the operation and the time unit from the controls.
Tool.steps_date-calculator_3Desc: The calculated date displays instantly. Copy the result for project deadlines, delivery estimates, subscription renewals, or event planning.
Tool.steps_bank-bin_1Desc: Type the first 6-8 digits of a credit or debit card (the Bank Identification Number). BINs identify the issuing bank, card brand, and card type.
Tool.steps_bank-bin_2Desc: Click Look Up to retrieve the card issuer, brand (Visa, Mastercard, etc.), card type (credit/debit/prepaid), and issuing country.
Tool.steps_bank-bin_3Desc: Click any field to copy it. Useful for payment processing verification, fraud detection, and understanding card payment infrastructure.
Tool.steps_currency-converter_1Desc: Input the amount, select source and target currencies from 170+ world currencies. Exchange rates are fetched live for accurate conversion.
Tool.steps_currency-converter_2Desc: The converted amount displays instantly based on current exchange rates. The rate used and last update time are shown for transparency.
Tool.steps_currency-converter_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the converted amount. Note: displayed rates are for reference — always verify with your bank before making large transactions.
Tool.steps_unit-converter_1Desc: Choose your measurement type: length, weight, or temperature. Switch between categories using the tab buttons at the top.
Tool.steps_unit-converter_2Desc: Type your number and select the source unit from the dropdown. The complete conversion table updates in real time showing all units simultaneously.
Tool.steps_unit-converter_3Desc: All unit conversions display at once in a clean table. Click any result to copy it. Perfect for engineering, cooking, travel, and science.
Tool.steps_text-encoder_1Desc: Type or paste text into the input area. The encoder supports multiple encoding formats for different use cases and programming needs.
Tool.steps_text-encoder_2Desc: Select the encoding — URL encode/decode, HTML entities, Base64, Unicode escape sequences, or binary. View encoded and decoded results side by side.
Tool.steps_text-encoder_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the encoded or decoded result. Perfect for web development, API parameter encoding, and data transformation tasks.
Tool.steps_online-notepad_1Desc: Begin writing in the editor — your content auto-saves to browser localStorage every 500ms. Close the tab and come back — your notes persist.
Tool.steps_online-notepad_2Desc: Format with Markdown syntax (headings, bold, lists, code). Toggle Preview mode to see rendered output. Switch between dark and light editor themes.
Tool.steps_online-notepad_3Desc: Download your notes as a .txt file or export to PDF with automatic word wrapping. No account needed — everything stays on your device.
Tool.steps_audio-trim_1Desc: Select an audio file (MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC, FLAC) to trim. The waveform visualizes your audio so you can see exactly where to cut.
Tool.steps_audio-trim_2Desc: Drag the start and end handles on the waveform to select the portion to keep. Preview the trimmed segment before committing to ensure it sounds right.
Tool.steps_audio-trim_3Desc: Click Trim to cut your audio to the selected range. Download the trimmed file — perfect for ringtones, podcast clips, and removing unwanted sections.
Tool.steps_audio-split_1Desc: Select a long audio file to split into segments. The waveform display helps you identify natural break points in the audio content.
Tool.steps_audio-split_2Desc: Split by fixed duration (every N minutes), by number of equal segments, or at manual split markers you place on the waveform.
Tool.steps_audio-split_3Desc: Click Split to divide your audio. All segments download individually or as a ZIP. Perfect for breaking long recordings into manageable episodes.
Tool.steps_audio-volume_1Desc: Select an audio file to adjust. Supported formats: MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC, FLAC. The file stays on your device throughout the entire process.
Tool.steps_audio-volume_2Desc: Drag the volume slider to boost (above 100%) or reduce (below 100%) the loudness. Click Preview to hear a sample at the new level before processing.
Tool.steps_audio-volume_3Desc: Click Apply to generate the volume-adjusted file. Download the result — ideal for normalizing audio levels across tracks or fixing quiet recordings.
Tool.steps_audio-convert_1Desc: Select the audio file to convert. Input formats: MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC, FLAC, M4A. Your file is processed entirely in your browser.
Tool.steps_audio-convert_2Desc: Select target format (MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC, FLAC) and bitrate. MP3 at 320 kbps offers the best quality-to-size ratio. WAV for lossless quality.
Tool.steps_audio-convert_3Desc: Click Convert to transcode your audio to the new format. Download the converted file — ready for any device, platform, or editing software.
Tool.steps_audio-merge_1Desc: Select two or more audio files to combine. Drag to reorder them in the sequence they should play. All files must be the same format.
Tool.steps_audio-merge_2Desc: Reorder files by dragging. Preview the total combined duration. Remove any file from the list before merging if needed.
Tool.steps_audio-merge_3Desc: Click Merge to combine all files into a single audio track. Download the merged file — ideal for podcast episodes, mixtapes, or audio compilations.
Tool.steps_audio-denoise_1Desc: Select an audio file with background noise — hiss, hum, fan noise, or static. The file loads in your browser for local noise profile analysis.
Tool.steps_audio-denoise_2Desc: Set the reduction strength. Start with a moderate level to avoid artifacts. Higher levels remove more noise but may affect voice clarity. Preview the result.
Tool.steps_audio-denoise_3Desc: Click Denoise to clean your audio. Download the processed file — ideal for podcasts, voice recordings, video voiceovers, and meeting recordings.
Tool.steps_add-watermark_1Desc: Select the photo or graphic you want to watermark. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP. Your image is processed entirely in the browser — nothing is uploaded.
Tool.steps_add-watermark_2Desc: Enter watermark text or upload a logo image. Adjust position, size, rotation angle, opacity, and color. The live preview updates instantly so you can fine-tune placement.
Tool.steps_add-watermark_3Desc: Click Apply Watermark to stamp your mark onto the image. Download the watermarked result — perfect for copyright protection, branding, or marking draft previews.
Tool.steps_drawing-canvas_1Desc: Start with a blank canvas or upload a background image to draw on top of. The canvas runs entirely in your browser using HTML5 — no plugins or downloads required.
Tool.steps_drawing-canvas_2Desc: Use the pen, shapes, and text tools to create your artwork. Adjust brush size, color, and opacity. Undo and redo are fully supported for easy experimentation.
Tool.steps_drawing-canvas_3Desc: Click Export to save your creation as a PNG image. The exported file includes all layers and edits — ready for sharing, printing, or further editing in other tools.
Tool.steps_image-batch_1Desc: Select or drag in a batch of images to process together. Supported formats include JPEG, PNG, and WebP. All files stay on your device — nothing is uploaded to a server.
Tool.steps_image-batch_2Desc: Select what to do with the batch: compress, resize to specific dimensions, convert format, or add watermarks. Settings apply uniformly to every image in the queue.
Tool.steps_image-batch_3Desc: Click Process to apply the operation to every image. Download results individually or as a single ZIP file. Ideal for preparing product photos, thumbnails, or web assets in bulk.
Tool.steps_aim-trainer_1Desc: Choose target size, spawn rate, and session duration. Start with larger targets and slower spawns if you're new to aim training.
Tool.steps_aim-trainer_2Desc: Click each target as quickly as possible as they appear. Your accuracy, hits per second, and total score track in real time.
Tool.steps_aim-trainer_3Desc: View your final score, accuracy percentage, and hit count. Track improvement over multiple sessions. Consistent daily practice yields the best results.
Tool.steps_cps-test_1Desc: Position your hand comfortably on your mouse. The test measures how many times you can click in your chosen time window.
Tool.steps_cps-test_2Desc: Click anywhere in the test area as fast as you can. The timer counts down and your CPS (clicks per second) updates in real time.
Tool.steps_cps-test_3Desc: Your final CPS score displays with a performance rating. Compare to global averages. Repeat to improve — different clicking techniques yield different results.
Tool.steps_reaction-test_1Desc: Watch the test area. It will change color from red to green at a random interval. Don't click before it turns green — that counts as a false start.
Tool.steps_reaction-test_2Desc: Click as fast as possible once the area turns green. Your reaction time is measured in milliseconds from the color change to your click.
Tool.steps_reaction-test_3Desc: Your reaction time displays in milliseconds. The average human visual reaction time is 200-250ms. Try multiple attempts — first attempts are usually slower.
Tool.steps_sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Choose your game, input your current sensitivity, mouse DPI, and any game-specific settings like FOV or aim type (hipfire/ADS/scoped).
Tool.steps_sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Select the target game or enter desired settings. The converter calculates the equivalent sensitivity for consistent aim feel across games.
Tool.steps_sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Copy the converted sensitivity value and paste it into your game settings. Fine-tune ±10% in-game to find your personal comfort zone.
Tool.steps_valorant-sensitivity-converter_1De: Type your current Valorant sensitivity value. This is the number found in Settings → General → Mouse → Sensitivity: Aim.
Tool.steps_valorant-sensitivity-converter_2De: Choose the game you want to convert to. The calculator uses proven mathematical formulas to match your 360° rotation distance across games.
Tool.steps_valorant-sensitivity-converter_3De: Copy the converted sensitivity and paste it into the target game's settings. Warm up in deathmatch for 10-15 minutes after changing sensitivity.
Tool.steps_cs2-sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Type your CS2 sensitivity from Settings → Keyboard/Mouse → Mouse Sensitivity. This is your base value for cross-game conversion.
Tool.steps_cs2-sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Choose the destination game. The converter matches your CS2 360° rotation distance to the equivalent setting in the target game.
Tool.steps_cs2-sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Copy the result, apply in-game, then fine-tune ±10% based on feel. Different game engines and FoVs affect perceived sensitivity even when mathematically matched.
Tool.steps_apex-sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Input your Apex Legends mouse sensitivity. Found in Settings → Mouse/Keyboard → Mouse Sensitivity. Enter your FOV and ADS multiplier if relevant.
Tool.steps_apex-sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Select the game to convert to. Apex's faster movement means converted sensitivity might feel different — give it several matches to adjust.
Tool.steps_apex-sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Apply the converted value in your target game. Test in the firing range or practice mode before jumping into competitive matches.
Tool.steps_overwatch2-sensitivity-converter_1: Input your OW2 sensitivity from Options → Controls → Mouse → Sensitivity. Note your FOV setting as it affects the conversion.
Tool.steps_overwatch2-sensitivity-converter_2: Choose the destination game. Overwatch 2's faster pace and vertical aim requirements mean the converted sensitivity may need minor adjustment.
Tool.steps_overwatch2-sensitivity-converter_3: Apply the converted sensitivity in your target game. Spend time in practice range adjusting to the different game feel and movement speed.
Tool.steps_r6siege-sensitivity-converter_1: Enter your Rainbow Six Siege sensitivity
Tool.steps_r6siege-sensitivity-converter_1Des: Input your R6 Siege sensitivity. Found in Options → Controls → Mouse Sensitivity. Include your ADS sensitivity settings for more accurate conversion.
Tool.steps_r6siege-sensitivity-converter_2Des: Choose the game to convert to. R6 Siege's slower, methodical aiming differs from faster shooters — give yourself time to adjust to the new game's pace.
Tool.steps_r6siege-sensitivity-converter_3Des: Apply the converted value. Practice in terrorist hunt or training grounds to build muscle memory with the new sensitivity setting.
Tool.steps_pubg-sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Input your PUBG general sensitivity, plus individual scope sensitivities if you use them. PUBG has separate settings for each magnification level.
Tool.steps_pubg-sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Select the game to convert to. PUBG's multiple sensitivity scopes can be converted individually to match each magnification in the target game.
Tool.steps_pubg-sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Apply the converted sensitivity. PUBG's realistic gunplay means the feel differs from arcade shooters — test in training mode first.
Tool.steps_fortnite-sensitivity-converter_1De: Input your Fortnite mouse sensitivity from Settings → Mouse Sensitivity. Include your targeting and scope sensitivities for a complete conversion.
Tool.steps_fortnite-sensitivity-converter_2De: Choose the game to convert to. Fortnite's third-person perspective and building mechanics make the aiming feel different from first-person shooters.
Tool.steps_fortnite-sensitivity-converter_3De: Apply the converted sensitivity. Building and editing sensitivity may need separate adjustment — focus on aim feel first.
Tool.steps_cod-sensitivity-converter_1: Enter your Call of Duty sensitivity
Tool.steps_cod-sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Input your CoD mouse sensitivity. Found in Settings → Controller/Mouse → Mouse Sensitivity. Note your ADS sensitivity multiplier as well.
Tool.steps_cod-sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Choose the destination game. CoD's fast time-to-kill means precise aim matters less than in tactical shooters — converted sensitivity may feel slightly different.
Tool.steps_cod-sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Apply the converted value. Play a few matches in casual mode to adjust before taking it into ranked or competitive play.
Tool.steps_tarkov-sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Input your Escape from Tarkov mouse sensitivity from Settings → Controls → Mouse Sensitivity. Include your ADS sensitivity for accurate conversion.
Tool.steps_tarkov-sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Choose the game to convert to. Tarkov's realistic weapon handling and separate hipfire/ADS sensitivities make conversion more nuanced than arcade shooters.
Tool.steps_tarkov-sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Apply the converted sensitivity. Test in offline mode or Scav runs before risking your PMC gear with unfamiliar sensitivity settings.
Tool.steps_bf2042-sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Input your BF2042 mouse sensitivity from Settings → Mouse & Keyboard → Mouse Sensitivity. Note your soldier zoom sensitivity for each magnification.
Tool.steps_bf2042-sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Choose the destination game. BF2042's vehicle gameplay and large maps mean sensitivity needs differ between infantry and vehicle combat.
Tool.steps_bf2042-sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Apply the converted value. Test in Portal mode or against bots to find your comfort zone before playing competitive multiplayer.
Tool.steps_halo-sensitivity-converter_1Desc: Input your Halo Infinite mouse sensitivity. Found in Settings → Mouse → Mouse Sensitivity. Include zoom level sensitivities for scoped weapons.
Tool.steps_halo-sensitivity-converter_2Desc: Choose the game to convert to. Halo's longer time-to-kill rewards tracking aim — the converted sensitivity should prioritize smooth tracking over flick speed.
Tool.steps_halo-sensitivity-converter_3Desc: Apply the converted sensitivity. Practice tracking aim in the Academy or bot matches before jumping into ranked arena.
Tool.steps_thefinals-sensitivity-converter_1D: Input your The Finals mouse sensitivity from Settings → Mouse → Sensitivity. Include ADS sensitivity multiplier and FOV setting.
Tool.steps_thefinals-sensitivity-converter_2D: Choose the game to convert to. The Finals' fast movement and destruction mechanics create a unique aiming feel — converted sensitivity may need adjustment.
Tool.steps_thefinals-sensitivity-converter_3D: Apply the converted value. Test in Quick Cash mode for a low-stakes environment to dial in your sensitivity before tournament play.
Tool.steps_warframe-sensitivity-converter_1De: Input your Warframe mouse sensitivity from Options → Controls → Mouse Sensitivity. Warframe's third-person fast movement differs from standard shooters.
Tool.steps_warframe-sensitivity-converter_2De: Choose the game to convert to. Warframe's parkour and ability-based gameplay mean aim feel translates differently to traditional shooters.
Tool.steps_warframe-sensitivity-converter_3De: Apply the converted sensitivity. Spend time in low-level missions adjusting to the new game's aiming mechanics and movement style.
Tool.steps_cs2-to-valorant-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your CS2 sensitivity value. The standard conversion formula is CS2 sensitivity ÷ 3.18 = Valorant sensitivity.
Tool.steps_cs2-to-valorant-sensitivity_2Desc: Your Valorant equivalent sensitivity displays instantly. Both hipfire and zoom sensitivity are calculated for a complete conversion.
Tool.steps_cs2-to-valorant-sensitivity_3Desc: Copy the result and paste it into Valorant Settings → General → Mouse → Sensitivity: Aim. Fine-tune ±10% to match your personal feel.
Tool.steps_valorant-to-cs2-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your Valorant aim sensitivity. The formula is Valorant sensitivity × 3.18 = CS2 sensitivity.
Tool.steps_valorant-to-cs2-sensitivity_2Desc: The equivalent CS2 sensitivity appears instantly. Both are mathematically matched to produce the same cm/360° rotation distance.
Tool.steps_valorant-to-cs2-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in CS2 Settings → Keyboard/Mouse → Mouse Sensitivity. Play deathmatch to adjust — CS2's movement feel differs from Valorant despite matched sensitivity.
Tool.steps_apex-to-valorant-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your Apex sensitivity and FOV. Apex's higher FOV default (110) vs Valorant (103) affects perceived sensitivity.
Tool.steps_apex-to-valorant-sensitivity_2Desc: The converted Valorant sensitivity accounts for FOV differences between the two games for a more accurate feel translation.
Tool.steps_apex-to-valorant-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in Valorant. Expect an adjustment period — Apex's fast movement contrasts with Valorant's tactical, hold-angle playstyle.
Tool.steps_valorant-to-apex-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your Valorant sensitivity. The converter adjusts for Apex Legends' higher default FOV and different game engine.
Tool.steps_valorant-to-apex-sensitivity_2Desc: The Apex sensitivity value adjusts for FOV scaling and engine differences. Both hipfire and ADS sensitivities are calculated.
Tool.steps_valorant-to-apex-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in Apex Legends. Test in the Firing Range with different weapons — tracking aim is more important in Apex than in Valorant.
Tool.steps_cs2-to-apex-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your CS2 mouse sensitivity. The converter accounts for the different FOV defaults between CS2 and Apex Legends.
Tool.steps_cs2-to-apex-sensitivity_2Desc: Your Apex equivalent sensitivity is calculated. The result is adjusted for Apex's wider default FOV and different movement speed.
Tool.steps_cs2-to-apex-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in Apex Legends. Spend time in the Firing Range practicing tracking on moving targets before dropping into battle royale.
Tool.steps_apex-to-cs2-sensitivity_1Desc: Input your Apex sensitivity and current FOV. These values are used to calculate the CS2 equivalent sensitivity.
Tool.steps_apex-to-cs2-sensitivity_2Desc: The CS2 sensitivity displays instantly, accounting for FOV scaling differences. CS2's narrower default FOV makes sensitivity feel different.
Tool.steps_apex-to-cs2-sensitivity_3Desc: Apply in CS2. Play deathmatch for at least 15 minutes — CS2's emphasis on crosshair placement and pre-aiming differs from Apex's tracking focus.
Tool.steps_overwatch2-to-valorant-sensitivity: Input your OW2 sensitivity and FOV. OW2's faster movement and diverse hero abilities create a different aiming context than Valorant.
The Valorant sensitivity is calculated with FOV compensation. Expect it to feel slower due to Valorant's more tactical, angle-holding gameplay.
Apply in Valorant. The adjustment period may take several days — Valorant rewards precise crosshair placement more than OW2's tracking-heavy aim.
Tool.steps_valorant-to-overwatch2-sensitivity: Input your Valorant aim sensitivity. The converter scales it up for OW2's faster-paced, ability-heavy gameplay environment.
The OW2 equivalent displays instantly. The sensitivity is adjusted for OW2's wider FOV and faster character movement speeds.
Apply in Overwatch 2. Try different heroes in Quick Play — hitscan and projectile heroes may feel different even with the same sensitivity.

png-to-jpg.whatIs: The PNG to JPG converter transforms lossless PNG images into compressed JPG files entirely in your browser, making it ideal for reducing file size for photos and web assets. During the PNG to JPG conversion, any transparent areas are filled with a white background since JPG does not support transparency. This tool is the fastest way to shrink image files when transparency is not needed and smaller file sizes are the priority.
png-to-jpg.why: JPG's lossy compression algorithm is specifically designed for photographic images, producing files 60–80% smaller than their PNG equivalents with minimal perceptible quality loss at quality settings of 80 or higher. Converting in the browser means your images never leave your device, eliminating privacy concerns associated with server-side converters. Secondary benefits include faster page load times, reduced storage costs, and broad compatibility across every operating system, email client, and image viewer.
png-to-jpg.useCases: E-commerce stores frequently convert product photos from PNG to JPG to reduce page weight and improve Core Web Vitals scores without sacrificing visual quality. Photographers sharing galleries online use PNG to JPG conversion to make high-resolution shots practical for email attachments and social media uploads. Web developers converting design exports or screenshots to JPG get dramatically smaller assets that accelerate site performance.
png-to-jpg.tips: Use a quality setting between 80 and 90 for the best balance of file size and visual fidelity — going below 75 introduces visible compression artifacts on edges and gradients. If your PNG contains a non-white background color behind transparency, set the background fill color before converting to avoid unexpected white halos.

jpg-to-png.whatIs: The JPG to PNG converter re-encodes compressed JPG images into lossless PNG format, preserving every pixel exactly as-is without introducing additional compression artifacts. JPG to PNG conversion is essential whenever you need to layer an image over a colored background, add a drop shadow, or edit the image further without accumulating JPEG generation loss. The resulting PNG file supports full transparency and is the preferred format for graphics, logos, and images requiring further editing.
jpg-to-png.why: PNG's lossless compression ensures that once you convert from JPG to PNG, subsequent saves and re-exports will not degrade quality the way repeated JPG saves do — making it the correct intermediate format for any editing workflow. The PNG format also supports an alpha channel, enabling crisp cut-outs and compositing that JPG simply cannot achieve. All processing happens client-side in WebAssembly, so your original photos and sensitive images are never uploaded to a server.
jpg-to-png.useCases: Graphic designers who receive JPG assets from clients convert them to PNG before compositing in Figma or Photoshop to avoid double compression during export. Social media managers preparing branded image overlays convert background photos to PNG so transparency can be added in a subsequent step. Developers building image pipelines use JPG to PNG as the first step when they need consistent, lossless source files for thumbnail generation.
jpg-to-png.tips: Be aware that converting JPG to PNG does not recover detail lost during the original JPG compression — it only prevents further quality loss going forward. For the smallest possible lossless PNG, ensure PNG compression is set to maximum (level 9) after conversion, which reduces file size without any quality penalty.

video-to-gif.whatIs: The video to GIF converter extracts frames from an uploaded video clip and encodes them into an animated GIF file, creating a looping animation that plays in any browser or app without requiring a video player. Video to GIF conversion is the standard way to create shareable reaction clips, product demos, and tutorial previews that embed natively in emails, chat platforms, and websites. The tool lets you control frame rate, dimensions, and loop behavior to balance animation smoothness against file size.
video-to-gif.why: Animated GIFs enjoy universal support across every platform, email client, messaging app, and social network without any plugin or player requirement, making them uniquely portable compared to video formats. Browser-based video to GIF conversion avoids installing desktop software like FFmpeg or Gifski, and processes files locally so raw video footage never touches a third-party server. Reducing frame rate to 10–15 fps during conversion can cut file size by 50% with minimal visible impact on short clips.
video-to-gif.useCases: Marketing teams create animated product teasers from short MP4 clips to use in email campaigns where video autoplay is unreliable. Developers embed GIF demos of UI interactions in GitHub READMEs and documentation sites where video tags are not supported. Content creators clip viral moments from screen recordings to share as standalone GIF reactions on social platforms.
video-to-gif.tips: Trim your source video to the shortest meaningful segment before conversion — GIF file size grows linearly with duration, so a 3-second clip at 15 fps produces a far more shareable file than a 10-second clip. Downscaling to 480px wide before conversion dramatically reduces file size while keeping the animation clear on most screens.

mp4-to-gif.whatIs: The MP4 to GIF converter specializes in transforming H.264 and H.265 MP4 video files into looping animated GIFs, handling the most common screen-recording and smartphone video format natively in the browser. MP4 to GIF conversion bridges the gap between high-quality video content and universally shareable animated images that require no player. The tool decodes MP4 frames directly in WebAssembly, making it fast even for moderately sized files without any server upload.
mp4-to-gif.why: MP4 is the dominant output format from screen recorders like OBS, QuickTime, and phone cameras, making a dedicated MP4 to GIF tool the most direct path from capture to shareable animation. Unlike video embeds, GIFs autoplay silently and loop indefinitely without user interaction, which is ideal for demonstrating software features or short tutorials. Client-side processing in the browser means proprietary screen recordings, confidential demos, and personal videos stay entirely on your device.
mp4-to-gif.useCases: SaaS companies convert MP4 screen recordings of new features into GIFs to embed in changelogs, Notion docs, and support articles where video embeds are cumbersome. Game streamers clip highlight moments from MP4 recordings and convert them to GIF for Discord servers and Twitter posts. UX researchers animate prototype interactions from MP4 exports to include in slide decks and user-testing reports.
mp4-to-gif.tips: For software UI recordings, use 20–24 fps to preserve the smoothness of animations and transitions; for talking-head or product clips, 12 fps is usually sufficient and keeps file size manageable. If the output GIF looks washed out, it is likely due to GIF's 256-color palette limit — try reducing the clip to scenes with fewer distinct colors for a sharper result.

webp-to-jpg.whatIs: The WebP to JPG converter decodes Google's WebP format and re-encodes the image as a universally compatible JPG file, solving compatibility issues in applications and operating systems that do not yet support WebP natively. WebP to JPG conversion is especially useful when downloading images from modern websites that serve WebP and then needing to open or share them in older software. Any transparent areas in the source WebP are replaced with a white background during conversion since JPG does not support an alpha channel.
webp-to-jpg.why: Despite WebP's excellent compression, Windows Explorer thumbnail previews, older versions of Adobe software, many email clients, and most print workflows still expect JPG or PNG rather than WebP, making conversion essential for real-world use. Browser-based WebP to JPG conversion requires no extension or third-party app — simply drag in the file and download the result in seconds. JPG output also offers broader sharing compatibility on platforms and devices that predate WebP support.
webp-to-jpg.useCases: Designers who download reference images or stock assets from modern image sites frequently get WebP files they need to convert to JPG before importing into Photoshop or Illustrator. Bloggers and content editors copying images from product pages receive WebP downloads that must be converted to JPG to attach in email newsletters or CMS uploads. Photographers archiving web-scraped images convert WebP to JPG for consistent storage in photo management software like Lightroom.
webp-to-jpg.tips: Set the output JPG quality to 90 or above when converting WebP files that were originally lossless to minimize quality degradation from the conversion. If the source WebP uses transparency, choose your background fill color deliberately — white is safe for print but may clash on a dark-themed website.

jpg-to-webp.whatIs: The JPG to WebP converter re-encodes JPG photographs and images into Google's WebP format, which delivers 25–35% smaller file sizes at equivalent visual quality, making it a powerful tool for web performance optimization. JPG to WebP conversion is the recommended upgrade path for existing image libraries targeting modern browsers, which all support WebP natively as of 2023. The converter runs entirely in the browser using WebAssembly, processing images at native speed without any server upload.
jpg-to-webp.why: WebP's advanced compression algorithm combines lossy and lossless modes with built-in alpha support, making it a strict improvement over JPG for web delivery in terms of both quality and file size. Reducing image payload through JPG to WebP conversion directly improves Google PageSpeed Insights scores, Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) timings, and bandwidth costs on high-traffic sites. Since conversion happens client-side, sensitive or proprietary product photos are never transmitted to an external service.
jpg-to-webp.useCases: E-commerce developers bulk-convert existing JPG product image libraries to WebP to improve site speed and SEO without re-shooting photography. Web performance consultants run JPG to WebP conversion as part of a site audit to demonstrate potential bandwidth savings to clients. Content teams maintaining image-heavy editorial sites convert article photography to WebP to reduce CDN costs and improve mobile load times.
jpg-to-webp.tips: A WebP quality setting of 80–85 matches the visual quality of a JPG at quality 90 while being 30% smaller — start there and only increase if you notice visible artifacts on gradients or fine textures. Use the `<picture>` element with a WebP `<source>` and a JPG fallback in HTML to serve WebP to modern browsers while maintaining compatibility for older ones.

webp-to-png.whatIs: The WebP to PNG converter decodes WebP images — including those with transparency — and outputs a lossless PNG file, preserving the full alpha channel and every pixel without introducing any additional compression artifacts. WebP to PNG conversion is the right choice when you need a lossless, universally editable version of a WebP image for use in design tools or print workflows. The tool handles both lossy and lossless WebP source files and correctly transfers transparency to the PNG alpha channel.
webp-to-png.why: PNG is the universal lossless format accepted by virtually every image editor, design tool, and operating system, making it the safest target when compatibility and quality preservation are paramount. Browser-based WebP to PNG conversion avoids the installation of command-line tools like libwebp's dwebp utility, democratizing the conversion for non-technical users. The lossless nature of PNG output means the converted file is safe to edit and re-export repeatedly without accumulating quality loss.
webp-to-png.useCases: UI designers who download icon sets or interface assets from design repositories in WebP format convert them to PNG for use in Figma, Sketch, or Affinity Designer. Front-end developers converting WebP sprites to PNG for use in environments or build tools that lack WebP decoder support. Archivists preserving web-scraped graphics prefer WebP to PNG conversion to ensure long-term readability in any image viewer.
webp-to-png.tips: If your WebP source has a transparent background, confirm the PNG output correctly shows the alpha channel by placing it over a colored background before using it in a project. PNG files from WebP conversion will typically be larger than the original WebP — this is expected and is the trade-off for universal compatibility and lossless quality.

png-to-webp.whatIs: The PNG to WebP converter encodes PNG images into Google's WebP format, which produces files approximately 26% smaller than equivalent PNG files at the same perceived quality, making it an excellent tool for web image optimization. PNG to WebP conversion supports both lossy and lossless WebP output modes, so transparent PNGs can be converted to lossless WebP with full alpha-channel preservation. This tool is a direct upgrade path for teams looking to modernize their web image assets without re-exporting from source files.
png-to-webp.why: WebP's superior compression means PNG to WebP conversion reduces bandwidth usage and storage costs for image-heavy websites, directly improving performance metrics like Time to First Byte and Largest Contentful Paint. Unlike PNG, WebP supports both lossy and lossless compression as well as animation in a single format, making it more versatile for modern web development. All conversion processing happens in-browser with WebAssembly, ensuring that design assets and proprietary graphics are never sent to an external server.
png-to-webp.useCases: Developers optimizing a Next.js or Gatsby site convert exported PNG assets to WebP to leverage automatic WebP serving and reduce bundle sizes. Graphic designers preparing assets for web handoff convert lossless PNGs to lossless WebP to give developers the best balance of quality and file size. Digital marketers converting banner ads and promotional graphics from PNG to WebP see measurable improvements in ad load speed and engagement.
png-to-webp.tips: Use lossless WebP mode for logos, icons, and text-heavy graphics where sharp edges must be preserved; switch to lossy mode at quality 85 for photographic PNG sources to gain the maximum file-size reduction. Test WebP output in all target browsers — while modern browsers all support WebP, some email clients and older CMS platforms still do not.

heic-to-jpg.whatIs: The HEIC to JPG converter transforms Apple's High Efficiency Image Container files — the default photo format captured by iPhone and iPad cameras — into universally compatible JPG files that open everywhere. HEIC to JPG conversion solves the frustrating incompatibility between iOS-captured photos and Windows PCs, Android devices, web upload forms, and older software that cannot read HEIC natively. The converter handles HEIC files produced by all modern iPhone models and preserves color accuracy during the conversion.
heic-to-jpg.why: HEIC offers excellent compression for Apple devices but is not natively supported by Windows Explorer, most web browsers, Adobe Lightroom Classic without a plugin, and the majority of online platforms — making HEIC to JPG conversion an essential step before sharing or uploading iPhone photos in professional contexts. Processing HEIC files in the browser eliminates the need to install Apple's HEVC codec pack or third-party desktop software. JPG output is accepted by every web form, email client, social platform, and print service globally.
heic-to-jpg.useCases: iPhone users submitting photos to government portals, insurance claim forms, or medical intake systems that require JPG format convert HEIC camera photos before upload. Photographers who shoot on iPhone and edit in Windows-based software convert HEIC to JPG as the first step in their editing workflow. Businesses receiving photo submissions from customers on iPhones convert HEIC files to JPG for storage in CMS platforms or image databases that lack HEIC support.
heic-to-jpg.tips: AirDrop or email your HEIC photos from iPhone to your computer rather than using iCloud download — iCloud sometimes auto-converts to HEIC which our tool handles, but direct transfer preserves the original HEIC for best quality. Set conversion quality to 95 when archiving memories to minimize visible JPG compression on detailed shots.

heic-to-png.whatIs: The HEIC to PNG converter decodes Apple's HEIC photo format and produces a lossless PNG file, making iPhone and iPad camera photos available in a format that is both universally compatible and free from any additional lossy compression. HEIC to PNG conversion is the preferred choice over HEIC to JPG when the converted image will be further edited, composited, or used as a design asset where compression artifacts would be problematic. The tool correctly handles HDR metadata and wide-color HEIC images captured on recent iPhones.
heic-to-png.why: PNG's lossless encoding ensures that HEIC photos converted to PNG retain maximum detail without the compression artifacts that HEIC to JPG introduces, which is critical for product photography, document scanning, and any image that will be edited further. Unlike HEIC, PNG is accepted natively by Windows, all Linux distributions, every major design application, and all web browsers without requiring codec installation. Client-side processing means personal photos from your camera roll never leave your device.
heic-to-png.useCases: Real estate photographers shooting on iPhone convert HEIC property photos to PNG before retouching in GIMP or Affinity Photo to avoid double-compression during the edit and export cycle. E-commerce sellers photographing products with an iPhone convert HEIC to PNG to get the cleanest possible source file before background removal and color correction. Archivists digitizing documents using an iPhone camera convert HEIC scans to PNG to ensure long-term readability and lossless preservation.
heic-to-png.tips: HEIC to PNG conversions produce files that are significantly larger than the original HEIC — this is normal since HEIC is highly efficient and PNG is lossless. If you only need compatibility and will not be editing the image further, HEIC to JPG at quality 90 will give you a much smaller file with minimal visual difference.

avif-to-jpg.whatIs: The AVIF to JPG converter decodes AVIF images — the next-generation format developed by the Alliance for Open Media — and re-encodes them as universally compatible JPG files for use in applications and workflows that do not yet support AVIF. AVIF to JPG conversion bridges the gap between cutting-edge web image delivery and the legacy systems, design tools, and platforms that still expect JPG. The converter handles both standard and HDR AVIF files and maps wide-gamut colors to the sRGB space appropriate for JPG output.
avif-to-jpg.why: While AVIF is supported by Chrome, Firefox, and Safari as of 2023, desktop applications like Photoshop, Lightroom, and most CMS platforms still lack native AVIF decoding — making AVIF to JPG conversion essential for practical workflows. Server-side AVIF decoders are slow and complex to set up; browser-based AVIF to JPG conversion using WebAssembly provides fast, dependency-free processing without any installation. JPG output is guaranteed to open in every operating system, image viewer, and sharing platform in use today.
avif-to-jpg.useCases: Web developers who download AVIF assets from CDNs or modern image services convert them to JPG before importing into design tools for mockup creation. Content managers who receive AVIF submissions from contributors convert them to JPG for compatibility with older CMS media libraries. Researchers scraping modern websites that serve AVIF images convert files to JPG for analysis in traditional image-processing pipelines.
avif-to-jpg.tips: AVIF files often use 10-bit color depth; converting to 8-bit JPG may introduce subtle banding in smooth gradients — use a quality setting of 92 or above to minimize this effect. If the AVIF source contains HDR metadata, the converted JPG will be tone-mapped to standard dynamic range, which may appear slightly different in highlight areas.

avif-to-png.whatIs: The AVIF to PNG converter decodes AVIF images and outputs lossless PNG files, providing a compatibility bridge from the next-generation AOM format to the universally supported lossless raster standard. AVIF to PNG conversion is the correct choice when the source AVIF contains transparency or when the converted image will be used as a lossless intermediate for further editing. The tool preserves alpha channel information present in AVIF sources and outputs it correctly in the PNG alpha layer.
avif-to-png.why: PNG is the only widely supported format that offers both lossless compression and full alpha-channel transparency without requiring any special codec — making it the safest target for AVIF files that need broad compatibility. Converting AVIF to PNG in the browser avoids the need for command-line tools like avifenc/avifdec, which require compilation from source and are inaccessible to non-developers. The lossless PNG output is suitable as an archival format or as a source file for subsequent format conversions without accumulating generation loss.
avif-to-png.useCases: Frontend developers who receive AVIF icon or illustration assets from a design handoff convert them to PNG for use in build tools, CSS background references, and email templates that lack AVIF support. Digital archivists converting AVIF images scraped from modern websites to PNG ensure long-term preservability in formats that any future tool can decode. Designers importing AVIF assets with transparency into Figma or Sketch convert to PNG since those applications do not yet support AVIF natively.
avif-to-png.tips: AVIF to PNG conversion always produces larger files than the AVIF source because PNG is lossless and less compression-efficient — this is expected behavior, not a tool error. If the resulting PNG is very large, consider running it through a lossless PNG optimizer like OxiPNG or using the compress-image tool afterward to reduce file size without any quality loss.

svg-to-png.whatIs: The SVG to PNG converter renders scalable vector SVG graphics into fixed-resolution PNG raster images at a size you specify, making vector assets compatible with platforms and applications that require pixel-based images. SVG to PNG conversion is essential for generating app icons, Open Graph social preview images, email headers, and any context where SVG is not supported. Because SVG is resolution-independent, you control the output dimensions precisely — set them large for retina displays or print, and small for thumbnails.
svg-to-png.why: SVG is not universally supported in email clients, many CMS platforms, PDF generators, and image hosting services — converting to PNG removes all compatibility barriers while retaining the visual sharpness of the original vector art. Browser-based SVG to PNG rendering uses the browser's own SVG engine, ensuring that fonts, gradients, filters, and complex path shapes render exactly as they appear on screen. PNG's lossless compression is ideal for preserving the sharp edges and flat color areas typical of SVG-sourced artwork.
svg-to-png.useCases: App developers export SVG icons to PNG at multiple resolutions (1x, 2x, 3x) for iOS and Android app icon assets that require raster PNG formats. Social media managers convert SVG brand templates to PNG for use as Open Graph preview images, Twitter card images, and LinkedIn banners that must be PNG or JPG.
